title: Apply a schematic sheet template to the active sheet
summary: Applies a .SchDot sheet template to the active schematic by running the built-in Sch:ChangeCurrentTemplate process, resolving template names against the template folder from the workspace preferences.
phrasings: change the title block of a schematic sheet
set a .SchDot template on a sheet
run a built-in Altium process from an extension

commands.name: ChangeTemplate
commands.description: Apply a sheet template to the active schematic; returns the template file name before and after
commands.params: Template=<file name in the schematic template folder, or full path of a .SchDot> (default A4.SchDot)|Silent=<true|false> (default true; false only from the AD menu)
